source: user-provided ground-nav-egomotion bundle; training provenance is owner-reported and not independently verified
training_data: NVIDIA PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles egomotion labels; no dataset files are included
license: NOASSERTION for the model artifact; NVIDIA Autonomous Vehicle Dataset License Agreement applies to the stated training source; trained-model rights remain unresolved

cpu_baseline_fallback.implementation: standard-library math only; separate from ONNX Runtime

output.frame: vehicle frame at the end of the supplied history; not a global coordinate or corrected current pose

required_operator_attestations: the input is a ground-vehicle feature history with reviewed provenance
use is authorized for internal autonomous-vehicle/ADAS development using NVIDIA technology
the operator has rights to use this trained model artifact
limitations: The model has no supplied OOD detector; input-domain validation is not established.
Model-supplied position sigma is not an independently validated confidence or safety bound.
The bundle states that it has not been validated for closed-loop control or vehicle-in-the-loop use.
The model sees no road or future control input and cannot anticipate a turn that has not begun.
This repository path is a standalone offline ground-vehicle review only; no UAV, live navigation, planning, control, mission, or effector integration is permitted.
